sentences.en: The AIS has also demonstrated exercise improvement with an even simpler approach.

sentences.en: The 2nd persons plural were formerly (except in the perfect) -ades, -edes, -ides; it was only in the course of the I 6th century that they got reduced, by the, falling away of d, to ais, eis and is.

sentences.en: The In-Vitros, or IVs, were created to take the place of the AIs, or silicates, androids who had rebelled against their human masters and live in hiding, continuing their harrassing campaign against their hated creators.
sentences.vi: In-Vitros, hoặc IV, được tạo ra để thay thế cho AI, hoặc silicat, android, những người đã nổi dậy chống lại chủ nhân loài người của họ và sống ẩn náu, tiếp tục chiến dịch quấy rối chống lại những người sáng tạo đáng ghét của họ.

sentences.en: Shane Vansen (Kristen Cloke) saw her Marine parents murdered by rampaging AIs.

sentences.en: I mean, science fiction has had starships, warp drive, AIs, aliens of every description, yadda yadda yadda, but here we are in 2009 and we still don't have HAL-9000 or anything like it.
sentences.vi: Ý tôi là, khoa học viễn tưởng đã có tàu sao, ổ đĩa dọc, AI, người ngoài hành tinh trong mọi mô tả, yadda yadda yadda, nhưng chúng ta ở đây vào năm 2009 và chúng ta vẫn chưa có HAL-9000 hoặc bất cứ thứ gì tương tự.

sentences.en: By June, all AIs had confirmed that they were Year 2000 compliant.

sentences.en: Objective To study the radiological change of bilateral paravertebral muscles in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis (AIS) and analyze its potential importance.

sentences.en: Like many AIS women, when I was younger, I used a dilator —picture a big, not-fun dildo —so that sex would be comfortable when I got older.
